closures.reason: The candidate assumes ap_pipeline_reset() restores an immutable pre-tuning configuration. In the supported control contract, ap_pipeline_apply_tuning() updates pipeline->cfg, ap_pipeline_get_config() returns that current effective configuration, and ap_pipeline_reset() reinitializes from the current pipeline->cfg. Rewinding runtime tuning projection on RESET would therefore diverge from worker state.
